title: Ultragoal completion QA/red-team, vqapr 015-027 fix campaign
harness: real temp workspaces driven through the installed vqapr CLI entrypoint; no repository files modified

claimsExercised.claim: 015: run performs check's judgments and refuses; no escape flag; a refused run writes no record
claimsExercised.evidence: Every check-refusal reproduced identically by run with the same check.* codes and exit 1, across a look-ahead spec (decision at 17:00 vs fill at 15:30), an unlisted-instrument spec, a naive-date spec, and two materialization specs. `vqapr list runs` count unchanged across every refusal. No --force bypass exists for judgments; --force only replaces an existing record id and did not create a bad record.

claimsExercised.claim: 022: vqapr.fill carries run_id, producer_id, stage, event_time, sequence
claimsExercised.evidence: Read .vqapr/runs/<id>/tables/vqapr.fill.jsonl after a real run. Both rows carry all five. event_time=2024-03-06T06:30:00+00:00 = 15:30 Asia/Seoul = the execution instant, NOT the 04:00 decision instant, confirming the execution-clock claim.

claimsExercised.claim: 024: tables reported from both declaration surfaces; formations renamed instants
claimsExercised.evidence: run.complete emitted tables_declared:[] for a model declaring no diagnostic tables, correctly excluding the three framework tables. show run emitted {instants, rows} per table, never 'formations'. vqapr.fill instants=2 (distinct event_times), not collapsed to 1.

claimsExercised.claim: 025: the stale-skill message names a command that runs; no no-op --force added to install
claimsExercised.evidence: Tampered with an installed SKILL.md; skill list reported stale and named `vqapr skill install`; running it flipped current false->true. `skill install --force` rejected with UsageError: unrecognized arguments: --force.

claimsExercised.claim: 026: every new kind emits declaration or registrable:false; no KeyError
claimsExercised.evidence: Scripted loop over all nine kinds. Eight returned a valid declaration path; run-spec returned registrable:false and no declaration key. Single-key-read loop completed with no KeyError.

claimsExercised.claim: 017: template offers only real account modes; mistyped closed-set value names the permitted set
claimsExercised.evidence: Template shows 'LONG_ONLY or SIGNED', matching AccountMode exactly. check and run both refuse mode: LONG_SHORT with requirement='initial_account.mode must be one of: LONG_ONLY, SIGNED', examples=['LONG_ONLY','SIGNED'], and a nearest-match fix naming 'LONG_ONLY'. No exception repr anywhere in observed.

adversarialCases: materialization spec refused by check (output already registered + lookback uncovered): run refused identically, no dataset created
double-run of the same run_id without --force: refused with RunRecordExists, list runs unchanged
decision-after-fill look-ahead: both verbs refused with check.execution.not_after_decision, run wrote no record
naive/date-only start: both verbs refused with check.period.uncovered

claimsExercised.claim: check/run refusal-code equality holds across every materialization failure mode
claimsExercised.evidence: Seven distinct malformed materialization specs driven through the real CLI entrypoint: unregistered component, wrong-kind component, output already registered, empty evaluate_at, naive evaluate_at, no instruments, and kind-ambiguous. All seven produced EQUAL refusal code sets from check and run. This exceeds the single case the committed test drives.

claimsExercised.claim: a refused materialization registers no dataset
claimsExercised.evidence: vqapr list datasets compared as JSON before and after each of the seven refusals; before == after in every case.

claimsExercised.claim: --run-id and --force are refused, not ignored, on a materialization spec
claimsExercised.evidence: Both produced code=1, stage=cli.input, with the flag name present in the refusal body.

claimsExercised.claim: the rewrapped explain expression in evidence/artifacts.py is behaviour-identical
claimsExercised.evidence: Constructed SimulationFailure(stage=CALLBACK_STATE, cause=RuntimeError) and read as_dict(): explain == 'component-contract' == str(_EXPLAIN_BY_STAGE[stage]); code == 'simulation.callback.state.RuntimeError'.

claimsExercised.claim: the import re-ordering introduced no circular import or load failure
claimsExercised.evidence: Purged sys.modules of vqapr.* and imported vqapr.flow.judgments, vqapr.cli.run, vqapr.evidence.artifacts in a forced order; no exception. judgments.__all__ unchanged at ['judgments','materialization_judgments'].

suite.note: Identical slow ran/skip profile, so the 1350 -> 1421 comparison is between two measurements of the same population. The real_data warehouse is provisioned on this host, so both numbers are the strong sense of green.
